title: AirQo Icons Flutter
subtitle: Open-source icon package for Flutter developers
description: A curated Flutter icon package published on pub.dev, providing a consistent set of icons for air quality monitoring applications. Designed to complement Flutter's built-in icon system with domain-specific iconography for environmental data visualization.
problem: Flutter developers building air quality and environmental monitoring applications lack a consistent, well-designed set of domain-specific icons. Using generic icons reduces the professionalism and clarity of data-heavy interfaces that need to communicate air quality levels, sensor types, and environmental conditions.
role: Designed the icon set, implemented the Flutter package structure, and published to pub.dev with proper documentation, versioning, and cross-platform compatibility testing.
approach: Created a minimal, consistent icon design language that works at multiple sizes and in both light and dark themes. Implemented as a Flutter package with proper asset management, ensuring icons integrate seamlessly with Material Design conventions while maintaining visual distinctiveness.
hardestDecision: Designing icons that are immediately recognizable at small sizes (16x16) while remaining visually interesting at larger scales — air quality concepts like PM2.5, AQI levels, and sensor types require abstract representation that must be intuitive without text labels.
outcome: Published on pub.dev and used in AirQo's Flutter applications. Open source under MIT license.
whatIdChange: Would add animated icon variants for real-time data visualization, implement a custom icon font for better web performance, and expand the set to cover broader environmental monitoring concepts.
